$comment: RESOLVED field map for the Big Think Capital production org (schema/API names only — no customer data). Generated from live describe discovery 2026-07-10 + manual resolution. Fields marked CREATE_PENDING below must be created in Setup (specs in docs/SALESFORCE-SETUP.md and PR notes) — SB-00 stays RED until they exist. Paste this file's content into the n8n env var SF_FIELD_MAP_JSON.

objects.$application_note: Org uses CS Broker Suite (csbs) — the 'deal' IS the Opportunity (13 record types); no separate application object. Submissions/offers/stips live in csbs__Submission__c / csbs__Offer__c / csbs__Stipulation__c and stay out of Emma's scope for now.

time_in_business.$note: existing CS Broker Suite text field

monthly_gross_revenue.$note: currency — chosen over csbs__Monthly_Revenue__c (string) for numeric extraction

funding_urgency.$note: generator suggested How_Soon_Are_You_Looking_To_Access_Funds__c but that is a HELOC-form field — rejected; create Emma field later if needed

current_positions.$note: collection disabled in qualification-rules; Opportunity position fields are underwriting-owned

ai_enabled.$note: CREATE_PENDING — checkbox, default TRUE. Deliberately NOT Activate_Sendblue__c: that gates the existing managed-package autotext automation

sms_consent.$note: CREATE_PENDING — checkbox, default FALSE. Twilio Opt_In objects exist but are Twilio-scoped; Emma needs a record-level flag

sms_opt_out.$note: CREATE_PENDING — checkbox, default FALSE. Kept separate from Do_Not_Contact__c (broader, all-channel); see open decision #3

missing_item_status.$note: csbs__Stipulation__c exists but stip disclosure needs compliance review first — unmapped = Emma never details missing docs, only the approved category wording

application_link.$note: REUSED existing e-sign application link field

application_link_sent_date.$note: CREATE_PENDING — datetime, optional (generator's Plaid_Link_Sent_At__c suggestion rejected — Plaid-specific)

appointment_status.$note: REUSED existing checkbox; Meeting_booked_time__c holds the datetime

last_inbound_date.$note: CREATE_PENDING — datetime, optional but recommended (enables reply-cancels-followup at SF level)

followup_date.$note: CREATE_PENDING — datetime, optional; without it SB-08 uses the Data Table fallback

ai_conversation_summary.$note: REUSED existing AI chat summary textarea

sendblue_conversation_id.$note: sendblue__Conversation__c managed object exists; integrate later if needed

timezone_field.$note: org has the Local Time (tz__) package — per-lead IANA timezone available for future per-customer quiet hours

extra_suppression_fields.$comment: Honored as additional suppression signals wherever fetched (recommended enhancement): if any is true, treat as suppressed even though sms_opt_out is Emma's primary flag.

owner_routing.$note: org has SDR/ISO routing automations — confirm with RevOps which queue takes Emma-created leads (open decision #4)
